_note: Hand card data for fullcard.py, keyed '<show or event slug>/<YYYY-MM-DD>'. 'matches' (+ 'source', 'source_name', optional 'image', 'name', 'time', 'network') = the whole card copied from the promotion's official preview or trusted outlets (any promotion/PLE). For WWE weekly shows the matches come from WWE.com automatically; an entry may add 'appearances' (advertised talent, with 'appearances_source') and 'venue'.
